description: 27 steps at a stonecutter: shift-clicks into the input by recipe and across the inventory, recipe buttons (one beyond the list), results by click, onto the cursor, by number key and shift-clicked until the input runs out, another item clearing the choice, the input given back on closing and dropped when the player leaves; and the update_recipes packet (254 stonecutter recipes in order, seven property sets) equal to both official servers'
